params.prompt: Premium e-commerce background film for the LuxeStyle Shop app. Use ONLY the supplied real brown ceramic swallow mug reference as the visual identity anchor: preserve the exact asymmetric organic handle, the two dark swallow motifs, brown glaze, rim thickness and full silhouette. The mug remains completely stationary on the same stone surface with the existing dry twigs at left. A real, controlled cinematic camera makes a tiny slow lateral arc of at most 2 degrees, creating genuine optical depth and foreground/background parallax; no flat 2D slideshow zoom. Soft warm window light grazes the glaze and the natural stone, taupe and cream editorial palette, refined calm physical materials, shallow realistic depth of field. One continuous 8-second shot, no cuts, no fade-in, no title card. Ease the camera back to its identical starting position for a seamless loop. Keep the entire handle and cup visible inside the central 70% width so a slight portrait crop remains safe. Upper quarter stays visually quiet for the app logo and the bottom fifth quiet for product cards; do not draw UI, logos, text, prices, stars or reviews into the film. No people, no hands, no added objects, no invented product operation, no liquid pour, no steam. No narration or audio. Photorealistic detailed ceramic; stable temporal consistency and smooth movement. Match the supplied first and final frame faithfully.

params.prompt: Create one premium 8-second silent cinematic background loop from the exact supplied ceramic mug photograph for a merchant profile. Product fidelity is the absolute priority. LOCK THE CAMERA COMPLETELY: no orbit, no dolly, no camera angle change, no pan, no zoom. The mug, organic loop handle, rim, two swallow bird decorations, stone slab, left stone and dry twigs must retain the exact same shape, orientation, relative positions and proportions in EVERY frame. Exactly TWO dark swallow motifs, as shown in the reference; never reveal or invent a third motif, text, logos or an unseen side. Do not rotate, translate, deform, reshape or animate the mug. Create motion ONLY through a very gentle physically plausible slow soft daylight/reflection shift across the BACKGROUND WALL and stone surface; a refined subtle warm sun reflection on the glaze may brighten and dim but must not redraw the texture or motifs. Start and end on the identical provided composition and illumination, return very gradually to the original light level, seamless loop. The reference photo's taupe/cream warm editorial styling stays intact. No smoke, no steam, no pouring, no people, no hands, no extra props, no added scene elements, no overlays, no UI, no captions or prices. No cuts or fades. Keep product pixels/shape consistent and the full handle visible; no transformations of the entire still photo.
